metadata.title: kuldev | websites, mobile apps, AI automations
metadata.description: I design and build websites, mobile apps and AI-powered automations. Modern, concrete, with character.

hero.title: Automations. AI first
hero.subtitle: I design and build digital products for businesses that want to look and work differently from the competition.

services.heading: Services

web.title: Websites and web apps
web.description: Company websites, online stores and browser-based apps, designed from scratch for your business. No off-the-shelf templates.
features: fast on phones and desktops, easy for search engines to find
tune-ups for existing sites: speed, SEO, ease of use
web.cta: Ask about websites and web apps

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: Phone apps for your customers or your team: bookings, orders, managing jobs in the field.
features: one app for both Android and iPhone
connected to your systems and data
designed for touch, not squeezed down from a website

automation.title: Automations and AI agents
automation.description: Software that takes over repetitive work: reports, documents, handling enquiries, moving data between systems.
features: finding where your team loses the most time
AI agents that answer customer questions or work with your company documents
integrations with the tools you already use
automation.cta: Ask about automations and AI agents

design.title: UX/UI design
design.description: Interface design before any code is written: how customers should move through your site or app to quickly do what they came for.
features: wireframes and visual design that fit your brand
a consistent design system built for years of growth

services.closing: I build every project from scratch and ship it with automated tests. Before anything reaches you, the code goes through quality checks, accessibility checks and testing on real phones. You get a product that works today and can grow tomorrow.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Describe your project and I'll get back to you with a concrete proposal within 1-2 business days.
